messages.text: Morning all. KYC queue is at 47 pending onboarding cases as of 9:45, up from 31 on Monday. Oldest is 6 business days. Anyone know why it's piling up?
Part of it is SanctionsScreen returning slow on batch hits. I'm seeing a bunch of cases stuck in 'screening in progress' for 40+ min before they clear.
Yeah, same on my side. Also a lot of the commercial entities are bouncing back for missing beneficial ownership docs, so those aren't really stuck on us.
Reminder that anything with a potential OFAC hit goes to me first before it gets released. Please don't clear those at L1 even if the queue is ugly.
Understood Nadia. I'll tag them 'sanctions-review' so you can filter quickly.
Taking {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0152}} refresh since it's flagged old. Low risk, client since 2017, but the ownership chart on file is stale. Need the updated {{CLIENT_EIN:c_0152}} cert too.
Did you check DocVault first? I think an updated filing came in through the RM last month, might not be linked to the case.
Good call, found it. It was uploaded but never attached to the KYC case. Linking now and rerunning the CDD check.

Pattern I'm noticing: docs land in DocVault but don't auto-associate with the case in KYCPipeline. That's probably 10+ of the pending items. Worth raising with Ravi's team since Ops still owns the pipeline?
Yes, please send it to Ravi Patel now. Ownership moves to Jenna Cho's group on 10/06, so I'd also loop her so the fix doesn't get lost in the handover.
Will do. I'll write it up with case examples and ask for a fix or a manual reconciliation script in the meantime.
FYI for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0152}}, contact info in ClientHub looks outdated. Phone {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0152}} goes to voicemail. Anyone have a better channel, or should I ask the RM?
Ask the RM, Joshua Gordon covers them. Email on file is {{CLIENT_EMAIL:c_0152}}, but I'd rather confirm through him before we send doc requests.
Update: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0152}} case cleared CDD and sanctions screening after the rerun. Queue is down to 41. Still have the doc-association issue to chase.
Nice. I sent the write-up to Ravi and Jenna with 12 example cases. I'll post their response here when I get it.
